common_cold.advice: Drink warm fluids, inhale steam, rest. Optional: Cetrizine for runny nose, Paracetamol for mild fever.

influenza.advice: Rest, hydration, light diet. Optional: Paracetamol for fever, Tamiflu if prescribed.

headache.advice: Rest, hydration, Paracetamol or Ibuprofen if needed.

migraine.advice: Rest in dark room, cold compress, avoid triggers. Optional: Sumatriptan if prescribed.

sore_throat.advice: Warm fluids, saltwater gargle, honey. Optional: Paracetamol if fever present.

runny_nose.advice: Drink warm fluids, steam inhalation. Optional: Cetrizine for allergy symptoms.

cough.advice: Hydration, honey, steam inhalation. Optional: Cough syrup, Paracetamol if fever.

sinusitis.advice: Steam inhalation, saline nasal rinse, hydration.

tonsillitis.advice: Warm fluids, rest, saltwater gargle. Optional: Paracetamol for pain.
